brief: 10s vertical (9:16) unnarrated comparison card: how a tennis ball bounces on clay vs hard vs grass courts. Three stacked surface panels (红土/硬地/草地), each with an animated ball trajectory over a ground line (clay = steep slow HIGH rebound, hard = medium regular rebound, grass = fast LOW skidding rebound), a drawn trajectory trail that persists, ITF pace-category pill (1类慢速 / 3-4类中速 / 5类快速), representative slam chip (法网/澳网·美网/温网), and two relative bars (球速保留 / 弹跳高度). Signature move: after all three panels have played once, all three balls replay SIMULTANEOUSLY so the speed/height difference reads side-by-side. Ends on tagline 同一颗球，三种脾气。 Account style: dark warm ink background, clay #C4563A + gold #E2BC68 accents, white #F8F6F3 text, heavy CJK sans (Hiragino Sans GB), pill chips matching the account's vertical-commentary card system.
